title: 第10章 《刑事侦查学》
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

周世通自己也是有女儿的人，所以每每提起也是难受万分，作为一个父亲，没有任何人能比得上宝贝女儿在他心里的位置。

司陇的眉头深深皱起。

这东西和她现实世界中的毒品一样，都是十分恶劣危害人类的东西，必须尽快处理。

“深蓝的源头查到了吗？”

“哎说到这就来气。”周世通忽然来了情绪，有些许激动。

“我在调来您这之前，就是A科室的科员，他们开展了几次蹲点搜捕行动，可那家KTV就像提前得知了消息一样，每次都干干净净的什么都找不出。”

“后来杨科长怀疑，是咱们局里有人通风报信，现在A科室内人心惶惶，大家都想揪出那个人。”

居然还有内鬼。

难怪冯野说这案子是要留着给她办的，不管是身份还是资历，并且怀疑有内鬼的情况下，确实她来处理最为合适。

坏人要抓，深蓝得禁，内鬼要揪出来，她的任务也要完成。

司陇忽然起身，在书柜中翻找起来，之前翻找办公室的时候记得有很多关于侦查方面的书。

随后抽出一本厚厚的《刑事侦查学》开始翻看，她一边看一边继续询问。

“沿海路那边，现在是个什么情况。”

“沿海路是咱们芒市的老城区，都是老旧建筑和小区，住的人也比较杂，那家奇缘KTV就在沿海路中心。老板叫孙大彪，本地人，四十岁。以前就是个没有正经工作的地痞混混，年轻时进过几次局子。但这个案子已经来回查了他很多遍，好像确实与他无关。”

司陇将目光从书上挪开，看了一眼周世通。

“一个从来没有正经工作的小混混，开了一家大型KTV？他得钱是大风刮来的。”

“杨科长当时也是和您一样的想法，他认为孙大彪背后一定有人，但他的账面银行往来，甚至人际关系网，都十分干净。”

一个老城区鱼龙混杂的娱乐场所，完完全全的干净，这才是最不正常的。

“周...额...小周，你去找一份奇缘KTV的建筑结构图给我，越详细越好。还有最近三个月内附近的所有异常事件报告都整理出来，我今晚要看。”

司陇刚想喊周世通，又觉得直呼其名怪怪的，忽然想起他说喊他小周就好，那就......小周吧，自己也算过了把瘾。

“您今晚就要看吗？”

周世通看了一眼窗外漆黑的夜色。

“现在已经快八点了，您今天刚做了手术，要不......”

司陇正看到书里的关键部分，头也没抬，伸出右手朝门口摆了摆，说道。

“快去快去。”

“好的明白，我这就去办。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Zhou Shitong himself also has a daughter, so he feels extremely uncomfortable whenever he mentions it. As a father, no one can compare to the position of his precious daughter in his heart.

Si Long frowned deeply.

This thing is the same as the drugs in her real world. They are very bad things that harm human beings and must be dealt with as soon as possible.

"Has the source of Deep Blue been found?"

"Hey, I get angry when I talk about this." Zhou Shitong suddenly became emotional and a little excited.

"Before I was transferred to you, I was a member of Section A. They carried out several raids, but that KTV seemed to have learned the news in advance. Every time, nothing was found."

"Later, Section Chief Yang suspected that someone in our bureau had tipped off the information. Now people in Section A are panicked, and everyone wants to find out that person."

There is actually a mole.

No wonder Feng Ye said that this case should be reserved for her to handle. Regardless of her identity or qualifications, and if she suspected a mole, it was indeed best for her to handle it.

The bad guys have to be caught, Deep Blue has to be banned, the mole has to be found out, and her mission has to be completed.

Si Long suddenly stood up and rummaged through the bookcase. When he was rummaging through the office before, he remembered that there were many books on investigation.

Then she took out a thick book of "Criminal Investigation Science" and started to read it. She continued to ask while reading.

"What's the situation on the coastal road now?"

"Hainan Road is the old city of Mangshi. It is full of old buildings and communities, and the people living there are relatively mixed. The Qiyuan KTV is in the center of Haihai Road. The owner is Sun Dabiao, a local, forty years old. He used to be a gangster without a serious job, and he was in the police several times when he was young. But this case has been investigated back and forth against him many times, and it seems that it has nothing to do with him."

Si Long took his eyes away from the book and glanced at Zhou Shitong.

"A little gangster who has never had a serious job opens a large KTV? He got the money because of the strong wind."

"Chief Yang had the same idea as you at the time. He thought there must be someone behind Sun Dabiao, but his bank transactions and even his interpersonal network were all very clean."

This is the most abnormal thing for an entertainment venue in the old city to be completely clean.

"Zhou...uh...Xiao Zhou, please find me a structural drawing of Qiyuan KTV. The more detailed the better. Also compile all the abnormal event reports nearby in the past three months. I want to read it tonight."

Si Longgang wanted to call him Zhou Shitong, but he felt it was weird to call him by his first name. Suddenly he remembered that he said he could just call him Xiao Zhou, so... Xiao Zhou, he was satisfied with it.

"Do you want to watch it tonight?"

Zhou Shitong glanced at the dark night outside the window.

"It's almost eight o'clock now. You just had surgery today. How about..."

Si Longzheng saw the key part in the book, without raising his head, he stretched out his right hand and waved towards the door and said.

"Go quickly, go quickly."

"Okay, I understand, I'll do it right away."
